verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own docs say agents built with Copilot can be tested, edited in Studio, and scheduled, which is a first-party scheduling capability. That is the only mention, with no detail on recurrence options, cron or interval configuration, or API/SDK scheduling. Zapier connectivity is a third-party integration and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedule configuration (cron/intervals, time zones), API or MCP access to create and manage schedules, schedule management and monitoring docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
